description: Sessions as a host hands them, with the critic's switch beside the tools (ADR-0010; tool-offer.json): the run's word (critic), the project's (criticProject), the critic's tier (criticReasoning), the host's two facts (existingPack, reviewerAssigned) and the alias before ADR-0010 (adversarialReview). The first is the composer's auto on a project whose default is off, the critic at ultra, on an existing pack; the second a reviewer's run the Desk sends as before, through the alias; the third an agent capability's run at an effort. Written by hand; criticSwitch.test.ts reads each through readCriticSettings, and go/context/critic_test.go through ReadCriticSettings.
